stem:
Jatin leaves a bottle of clear lime water (calcium hydroxide solution) open to the air. After some time the liquid turns milky. He wonders whether carbon dioxide or oxygen from the air reacted, and whether the milkiness comes from tiny particles of calcium carbonate or from calcium hydroxide itself.

Which claim is correct?

options.text: Oxygen from the air reacted; the milkiness comes from calcium carbonate.
Carbon dioxide from the air reacted; the milkiness comes from calcium carbonate.
Carbon dioxide from the air reacted; the milkiness comes from calcium hydroxide.
Oxygen from the air reacted; the milkiness comes from calcium hydroxide.

teacher.key_rationale: Carbon dioxide reacts with calcium hydroxide to form insoluble calcium carbonate particles that make the liquid look milky.
